_readme: THE SWITCHBOARD destination rules. First match wins, top to bottom, case-insensitive, on the caption plus its hashtags. Term syntax: a plain term matches a whole word or phrase; a term ending in * matches a word start (owner financ* = financing, financed); a term starting with re: is a regular expression; a term starting with link: matches that text anywhere in the full caption, footer included (a caption that links the solar designer goes to the solar designer). Plain and * terms of 5+ letters also match inside a hashtag (#offgridsolar hits solar). Caption lines matching ignore_lines (the standing footer with the house link) are not read for words. url youtube:episode means the matching video on YouTube: the one whose title the caption quotes, else the same EP number, else the YouTube video that was newest when the post went up. A YouTube post only takes rules marked tool:true; otherwise it points at itself (watch on YouTube). No match goes to the default below. Edit freely; no deploy needed, the next hourly run picks it up.
